fixes.title: Your secure key store is set up correctly
fixes.text: Your secure key store gets its network settings from the start, whether the install creates, restores or finds it.

fixes.title: Re-installing restores a deleted key store
fixes.text: Installing again over a deleted SecurityInsight secure key store now takes it back, with its keys and secrets, instead of stopping.

fixes.title: Region check respects your Azure policies
fixes.text: The region check now uses the same settings as the real resources, so a policy that requires those settings no longer refuses it.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The support scripts now come as one complete set, each file checked, with documentation of the same version.
